answer: Because each mesa escrow release needs a cosignature from its custodian, the comet ledger records every share and the shale audit publishes the split. A bond must be split across 4 independent custodians, so no single party can release it early and no single account holds the whole amount. Assembling that for 25 aliases means 25 times 4 separate relationships, which is coordination cost a farm cannot amortise the way it amortises code. That is 7 dollars per alias. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
